statement:
∀ (a : ℝ),
  Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[>] a) (𝓝 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[<] a) (𝓝 (-1)) ∧ ¬∃ L, Tendsto (fun x => |x - a| / (x - a)) (𝓝[≠] a) (𝓝 L)

goal.text:
